question_text: Evaluate using an ML language system as the sole assessor of student essays.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: It can provide rapid, consistent preliminary scoring across many submissions. However, training bias may disadvantage language varieties and an opaque score can be difficult to challenge; nuanced reasoning may be missed. Human moderation, transparent criteria and testing across student groups are needed, so sole automated assessment is not justified merely by speed.
partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
